name: War Knight: a Flames of Xoroth rank learned after Warbringer still casts Warbringer (#5273)
contract: Warbringer 570727 replaces Flames of Xoroth in War specialization 18 (TalentReplacements). The Book must keep selling Flames of Xoroth ranks to War Knights, because each Flames rank is the parent that unlocks the matching Warbringer rank (knight-warbringer-book-parent-gate-5279). A War Knight at level 48 who learns Flames rank 802415 after taking Warbringer therefore also knows Warbringer 802585, the Xoroth refresh maps 802415 to 802585 within its 250 ms period, and a client cast of the Flames id through CMSG_CAST_SPELL is redirected: Warbringer 802585 hits and Flames 802415 deals no damage.

steps.label: SETUP: Flames rank 802414 is replaced by Warbringer 802584
The War Knight learns the next Flames of Xoroth rank from the Book
Let the periodic Xoroth refresh run
CONTRACT: the new Flames rank unlocks Warbringer 802585
CONTRACT: the new Flames rank is replaced by Warbringer 802585
The client casts the Flames of Xoroth id
CONTRACT: Flames of Xoroth itself does not fire
